class.name: InputSystem
class.brief_description: Tracks key states and controls the mouse pointer.
class.description: Use the active engine input system to read game input. Press and release flags last until the end of the frame.

method.name: IsKeyDown
method.description: Checks whether a key is held down in the current processed input state.
method.param: The engine key code to check.
method.returns: True if the key is down. False if it is up or the code is outside the supported range.

method.name: WasKeyJustPressed
method.description: Checks whether a key was pressed during this frame. The flag is cleared at the end of the frame.
method.param: The engine key code to check.
method.returns: True if a press was processed this frame. False for a code outside the supported range.

method.name: WasKeyJustReleased
method.description: Checks whether a key was released during this frame. The flag is cleared at the end of the frame.
method.param: The engine key code to check.
method.returns: True if a release was processed this frame. False for a code outside the supported range.

method.name: SetCursorMode
method.description: Sets whether the mouse pointer is free or captured for camera movement. Values outside the supported range are ignored.
method.param: 0 for a normal pointer, or 1 to hide and capture it for camera movement.
